rules.expr: (clamp_min(time() - min by (worker, chain_id) (artgod_trading_bidding_scan_last_progress_at_seconds{worker=~"bidding-bot",chain_id=~".*"} > 0), 0) and (max by (worker, chain_id) (artgod_trading_bidding_scan_active{worker=~"bidding-bot",chain_id=~".*"}) > 0)) > 600

annotations.summary: Active bidding scan has no settled-job progress
annotations.description: Inspect active stages, OpenSea calls and logs. Long admitted work may be legitimate; this warning does not authorize retrying marketplace writes.

rules.expr: (clamp_min(time() - min by (worker, chain_id, stage) (artgod_trading_bidding_work_last_progress_at_seconds{worker=~"bidding-bot",chain_id=~".*"} > 0), 0) and (sum by (worker, chain_id, stage) (artgod_trading_bidding_work_active{worker=~"bidding-bot",chain_id=~".*"}) > 0)) > 600

annotations.summary: Active bidding stage has no start or completion progress
annotations.description: Inspect the stage and its child operations. A long traversal can still be progressing internally; this is an inspection warning, not proof of a deadlock.
